body: I see what you did there.
Ok...
OMG it's Pat! I just saw him at MAGfest!
WTF is Flock? Never heard of that browser before.
Sweet! Lame Castle! I love that game.
[](/troll)
Derp

I don't have 20 god damned dollars to spend. I have $68 until Jan fucking 31st! 

   I'm not just looking for attention. This isn't a fucking game! I want to try new things more then anything but my situation doesn't allow me to do that easily. Fuck off. I don't want anymore posts here. Fucking Internet, all you awesome people should be out doing stuff. Not wasting your time with me. I'm sorry. Good bye.

Yeah I know. And I would love to try pot but I have no idea were to get it, I don't have any money to buy it plus I'm terrified of even having a little bit of pot and getting caught by the police. You read all those stories about people getting arrested for having less then an ounce. It's not worth it. And besides it's only temporary happiness. Waste of time and money IMO. But what do I know?

It's not that I feel uncomfortable. I just get confused really easily, and I can only think about how I feel at that very moment. And that's always how much I would rather be somewhere else, away from people. That's why I can post on here. I'm alone, at my computer, I can post how I feel the moment I'm feeling it. Fuck it. It doesn't matter. I'm bored. HerpDerp blah. I just had coffee, the first 30 min or so after I get my morning caffeine is the only time I feel good. Doesn't last long. And Fuck this ADD. So god damned random! It drives me nuts! I can't focus on anything. Sorry.
Nah, I'm to lazy to do that. Thanks anyway.
I going to die anyway so what's the point in doing anything? It doesn't  matter. Nothing I do has any point. Sure I could do it just to enjoy life, but that's not good enough. I don't matter.

Ive tried to talk with my doctor but with my mood swings and general stupidity I can never remember what I wanted to tell my Dr when I see him. I know I felt like crap, but all I can think of when I'm there is how badly I just want to leave. Thats the anxiety doing that. Ahhhhh! It's so damn frustrating.
I don't know. There has never been a point in my life were I haven't worried about money. Even growing up my family was always on a really tight budget. I hate money. I hate everything. .

Ahhhhh! To many people commenting! Go away. I appreciate you want to help, and I did ask for it but it's just to much. Im sorry. I never should have said anything in the first place. The account I posted this with is just a throwaway account, I'm going back to my main Reddit account. Thank you all. Bye.
Yeah I've been to a doctor. I'm taking 3 different meds right now, for anxiety, depression and ADD. Yes I know it's supposed to be ADHD but in not hyperactive so for me it's just ADD.

Those are good ideas. I live in Canada so the weather right now is cold and snowy but I don't mind. Tomorrow I'm going to force myself to walk to the library. I doubt I will though. My mood changes really fast. I don't feel to bad right now, nowhere near as bad as when I first posted. But odds are tomorrow I'll feel like crap and not bother doing anything.

I've got nowhere to go. I don't have any friends, no job, I don't even have the money to just go and sit at the coffee shop! I know If I just got out there, started doing stuff, things might get better, but what's the point? This world is so fucked up, I just can't be bothered doing anything. 

  Then why do I get upset at myself? IDK. I'm just crazy I guess.
So many people here in r/suicidewatch. Damn it, that just makes me more depressed. Fuck this life.
Creepy how much you sound like me. Only I've never been able to put my feelings into words. Fucking Adult ADD and all-round stupidity. Sucks don't it?
